maj-12.exo: Sacrifice, waiting, suspension, voluntary renunciation for the sake of a greater good. It points to a stuck situation that asks for a change of perspective.
maj-12.psy: It represents the ego's surrender before what it cannot control; the overturning of values that precedes a new understanding.
maj-12.ini: Path 23 from Geburah to Hod, the letter Mem (water, 40) and elemental Water: the baptismal immersion in which individual form dissolves. It is the formula of the sacrificed god, belonging to the previous Aeon.
maj-12.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals victimhood, pointless sacrifice, passivity, a stalemate without meaning.
maj-12.up: Let go of control and look at the situation from another angle; a conscious renunciation can open the way.
maj-12.rev: Sacrifice that is imposed or dragged out beyond what is necessary; resistance to changing your point of view, a feeling of being trapped.
maj-12.love: Renunciations and waiting; watch relationships in which you give without receiving.
maj-12.work: Suspended projects and delays; a time to rethink methods and priorities.
maj-12.spirit: The surrender of the ego as an offering; immersion in the waters of transformation.
maj-12.crowley: For Crowley the Hanged Man expresses the formula of Osiris, the god who dies in order to rise again, which the new Aeon considers outdated: the man hangs from an ankh, nailed to a green grid, with a serpent at his feet announcing new life.

maj-13.exo: Deep transformation, the end of a cycle, irreversible change. It almost never points to a physical death: more often the necessary closing of a phase.
maj-13.psy: The process of letting old identities and attachments die; the mourning that makes rebirth possible.
maj-13.ini: Path 24 from Tiphareth to Netzach, the letter Nun (the fish, 50) and Scorpio, the fixed water of Mars: the alchemical putrefaction that precedes all regeneration. Scorpion, serpent and eagle are the three degrees of the same energy transforming itself.
maj-13.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals fear of change, stagnation, attachment to what has already ended.
maj-13.up: Something is closing to make room for the new: accompany the transformation instead of resisting it.
maj-13.rev: Resistance to an inevitable ending; a change postponed that becomes slow wear and tear.
maj-13.love: The end of a phase of the relationship, or a radical transformation of the bond.
maj-13.work: The closing of a project or a role; restructurings that prepare a new beginning.
maj-13.spirit: Dying to yourself in order to be reborn: transformation as initiation.
maj-13.crowley: Crowley paints a crowned skeleton dancing and, with his scythe, raising bubbles in which new forms sprout: death is a moment in the dance of life, not its opposite.

maj-14.exo: Balance, moderation, a successful combination of different elements. It points to creative solutions, healing and harmonisation.
maj-14.psy: The ability to integrate opposite parts of yourself into a new synthesis; creativity as a process of inner transformation.
maj-14.ini: Path 25 from Tiphareth to Yesod, the letter Samekh (the prop, 60) and Sagittarius, the mutable fire of Jupiter: the arrow of aspiration rising along the central pillar. Here the alchemical work begun in the Lovers is accomplished.
maj-14.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals confused mixing, lukewarm compromise, wrong doses that spoil the work.
maj-14.up: Find the right combination: the solution is born from fusing what seemed irreconcilable. Patience and a sense of measure are needed.
maj-14.rev: Elements that will not fuse, impatience, excess or lack; the alchemical process is interrupted before completion.
maj-14.love: Integration, creative compromise, a mature union between different characters.
maj-14.work: Innovative solutions, a synthesis of different skills, well-calibrated projects.
maj-14.spirit: Solve et coagula: the Work as a path of self-transformation.
maj-14.crowley: Crowley renames Temperance 'Art': an androgynous figure, a fusion of the king and queen of the Lovers, pours fire and water into a cauldron, and the alchemical formula V.I.T.R.I.O.L. appears in the background.

maj-15.exo: Material force, ambition, desire, bonds and temptations. It points to situations of dependence, but also to a powerful creative and sexual drive.
maj-15.psy: Your relationship with your own instincts and shadows: what you fear or desire until it dominates you, or which, once acknowledged, becomes strength.
maj-15.ini: Path 26 from Tiphareth to Hod, the letter Ayin (the eye, 70) and Capricorn, the cardinal earth of Saturn in which Mars is exalted: generative energy in its most earthly expression. The eye that sees the divine even in the lowest and the darkest.
maj-15.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals obsession, dependence, blind materialism, exploitation of yourself or others.
maj-15.up: Powerful creative energy and strong ambition: recognise the forces that move you and use them consciously.
maj-15.rev: Bonds that begin to loosen, or dependences that are denied; you need to look squarely at what you fear.
maj-15.love: Magnetic attraction, intense sexuality; possible dynamics of dependence or power.
maj-15.work: Ambition, tenacity, material power; watch out for ethical compromises.
maj-15.spirit: Pan as totality: welcoming even the shadow as part of the divine.
maj-15.crowley: For Crowley the Devil is Pan the begetter, a Himalayan goat laughing on the summit of the world: creative force without moral judgement, delighting in the harsh and the barren as much as in the fertile.

maj-16.exo: The sudden collapse of structures, conflicts, crisis. It points to events that tear down illusions and force change.
maj-16.psy: The moment when the ego is shaken by an unavoidable truth; the giving way of defences that precedes liberation.
maj-16.ini: Path 27 from Netzach to Hod, the letter Pe (the mouth, 80) and Mars: the lowest horizontal path, where fire destroys in order to purify. What is built on illusion cannot withstand the gaze that awakens.
maj-16.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals chaos, rage, violence, destruction for its own sake.
maj-16.up: Something false is collapsing: do not hold it up. The crisis makes room for truth and a healthier rebuilding.
maj-16.rev: A crisis postponed or lived internally; tensions accumulate, so it is better to face them before they explode.
maj-16.love: Ruptures or crises that reveal hidden truths; the end of an illusion.
maj-16.work: Sudden changes, organisational collapses; a chance to rebuild on new foundations.
maj-16.spirit: The awakening that demolishes the illusion of a separate, fortified self.
maj-16.crowley: In the Thoth Tower the Eye of Horus strikes the building with lightning while the jaws of Dis belch flames; the dove and the lion-headed serpent show that destruction carries peace and renewed desire with it.

maj-17.exo: Hope, renewal, inspiration. It points to healing after a crisis, trust in the future and unexpected help.
maj-17.psy: The ability to reconnect with a wider vision; the trust that is born from having crossed the dark.
maj-17.ini: Path 28 from Netzach to Yesod, the letter He (the window, 5) and Aquarius, fixed air: the window from which infinity can be glimpsed. Nuit pours out the waters of life and reminds us that every man and every woman is a star.
maj-17.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals illusion, disappointment, sterile idealism, hopes that have no roots.
maj-17.up: Well-founded hope and inspiration: the direction is right. A time of healing, renewal and trust.
maj-17.rev: Trust lost, vision clouded; you need to find your way back to your most authentic ideals.
maj-17.love: Sincere love, openness and mutual trust; the healing of emotional wounds.
maj-17.work: Inspiration, creativity, long-term vision; future-oriented projects.
maj-17.spirit: Recognising yourself as a star: divine individuality in an infinite cosmos.
maj-17.crowley: Following the correction 'Tzaddi is not the Star', Crowley assigns the letter He to the Star; the figure is Nuit pouring water from two cups, one of gold and one of silver, beneath the seven-pointed star of Babalon.
